commit d508a4c0911bf5103f7fb66c9627ef05691fc5aa
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
AuthorDate: Fri Mar 20 10:52:10 2026 -0600
Commit:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
CommitDate: Fri Mar 20 10:52:10 2026 -0600

    Bug 2017003 - Follow-up: Restore reliable screen reader interruptions for new mail alerts. r=mkmelin
    
    
    The previous patch stabilized the layout and async Fluent initialization
    sequence, but moving `role="alert"` off the root `body` node inadvertently
    stripped the notification of its OS-level System Alert priority. Consequently,
    screen readers (like JAWS) treated the delayed DOM injection as low-priority
    background noise and suppressed the announcement intermittently. Legacy XUL
    structures were also fracturing the reading flow.
    
    This follow-up refines the accessibility tree to guarantee reliable
    announcements without sacrificing the hardened layout sequence:
    
    - Restore `role="alert"` to the `<html:body>` tag so Gecko correctly broadcasts
      a top-level, high-priority system alert to the OS window manager.
    - Implement an `aria-hidden="true"` cloak-and-reveal strategy for
      `#alertTextBox`. The container now renders visually so `scrollHeight`
      calculations remain accurate, but stays hidden from the accessibility tree.
      Removing `aria-hidden` after the layout sequence settles forces a monolithic
      DOM mutation that reliably triggers screen reader interruptions.
    - Add `role="presentation"` to the inner XUL `<vbox>` and `<hbox>` wrappers
      inside `folder-summary` to flatten the accessibility tree and prevent the
      layout nodes from breaking the screen reader's continuous reading flow.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D288877

diff --git a/mail/base/content/widgets/foldersummary.js b/mail/base/content/widgets/foldersummary.js
index 109a64cf601..cde7c489f68 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/widgets/foldersummary.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/widgets/foldersummary.js
@@ -46,9 +46,11 @@
     static createFolderSummaryMessage() {
       const vbox = document.createXULElement("vbox");
       vbox.setAttribute("class", "folderSummaryMessage");
+      vbox.setAttribute("role", "presentation");
 
       const hbox = document.createXULElement("hbox");
       hbox.setAttribute("class", "folderSummary-message-row");
+      hbox.setAttribute("role", "presentation");
 
       const subject = document.createXULElement("label");
       subject.setAttribute("class", "folderSummary-subject");
diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
index b94f1b20550..93bf6c585fa 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
+++ b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
@@ -142,6 +142,16 @@ async function doOnAlertLoad() {
     }, 100);
   });
 
+  // Give the OS accessibility layer a moment to register the alert region
+  // before uncloaking its content. Removing aria-hidden forces screen readers
+  // (JAWS, NVDA, Orca) to announce the fully populated text.
+  setTimeout(() => {
+    if (!alertTextBox.isConnected) {
+      return;
+    }
+    alertTextBox.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
+  }, 150);
+
   const openTime = Services.prefs.getIntPref("alerts.totalOpenTime");
   var alertContainer = document.getElementById("alertContainer");
   // Don't fade in if the prefers-reduced-motion is true.
diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.xhtml b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.xhtml
index e6aecffd1f1..7205cd67e09 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.xhtml
+++ b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.xhtml
@@ -26,6 +26,7 @@
   </head>
   <html:body
     xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
+    role="alert"
   >
     <hbox id="alertContainer" align="start">
       <hbox id="alertImageBox" align="center" pack="center">
@@ -37,7 +38,7 @@
         />
       </hbox>
 
-      <vbox id="alertTextBox" role="alert">
+      <vbox id="alertTextBox" aria-hidden="true">
         <html:div id="alertTitle"></html:div>
         <html:hr id="alertSeparator" />
         <folder-summary id="folderSummaryInfo" />
